event.title: docs(specs): piece rendering capability; cover Firebase entry and IdPrefix (rebased on main)
event.author: predictable-code[bot]
event.body:
## Why

#19 no longer merges: #18 (design tokens) landed on main with the same design-tokens spec, tokens test and vite.config.ts change, and the capability metadata lines of island-server-rendering and mcp-transports changed on main, so #19 shows CONFLICTING. Without it, scripts/render (renderTalk, checkSpelling, the tag rules) has no capability, and mcp/firebase.ts and src/runtime/compat/react.ts IdPrefix stay undocumented per 'predictable specs undocumented'.

## What changed

Same documentation as #19, rebuilt on current main: adds the Piece rendering capability (SPEC-544, scripts/render/*), and with 'predictable specs cover' records mcp/firebase.ts on MCP transports (SPEC-264) and src.runtime.compat.react.IdPrefix on Island server rendering (SPEC-403). The design-tokens parts of #19 are already on main through #18 and are left out. Supersedes #19, which can be closed. No code changed.

## How it was verified

Not verified by the analysis: no `predictable fix-check` in this session reported a defect gone for this change. Review it as an unverified change.
